answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining the market, scaled by the number of identities it controls. An operator spinning up a thousand sock puppets must lock up a thousand deposits, so cost grows linearly while payoff does not. Reputation then travels on a trust graph: each verified trade adds a vertex linking buyer and seller, and an agent with no honest neighbors sits on an isolated island nobody trades with. Even if a sybil cluster builds a loud echo chamber praising itself, outsiders see only self-referential links and no counterparty history, so it earns nothing.
